items.briefing:
Security firm WatchGuard is warning that cybercriminals are shifting away from mass attacks toward more targeted campaigns, meaning Australian businesses of all sizes could be in the crosshairs. Separately, the Akira ransomware group is actively exploiting a vulnerability in SonicWall devices that has existed for two years — if your organisation uses SonicWall, check with your IT team that it has been patched. Microsoft has also disrupted a phishing service called EvilTokens, which was tricking users into handing over account access through fake device login prompts.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected login request or device approval prompt — even from a service you trust — do not approve it without confirming it's legitimate with your IT team first.
